description:
A small electronic keyboard sits on a green bedspread in front of you, with a pillow propped up behind it.  
The left hand rests on the lower keys and makes small shifts slightly to the right while pressing different notes, while the right hand starts nearer the middle, moves to the right, then dips down and left along the higher keys to play; the keyboard is a two-hand object throughout as both hands keep touching and tapping the keys.
